community_list_entries.name: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills

phase1_classification.kind_reason: It introduces a benchmark for streaming embodied skill discovery, using RoboInter and HD-EPIC videos and evaluating 19 VLMs. A model keeps a persistent skill library across videos and is scored on event localization, skill grouping and reuse-vs-create decisions. Data is on HF at Sterzhang/video2skil
